'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Matt Scott DS Hoth''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Scott]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (Dark)|Hoth-D-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
